title: ASHLAR Map 01 concept brief (monster lineups + environment kits)
status: planned (no image is claimed as generated by this brief; see pilot flags on U01_A and U01_B)
overwritePolicy: never overwrite an existing output; retries use a new filename suffix (e.g. concept_v2.png)
monsterLayoutRule: ONE wide lineup per variant: one human silhouette H at left + five full-body views (3/4, LEFT, RIGHT, FRONT, BACK) on ONE shared baseline and ONE shared scale. Very broad/tall monsters (P06, B05) use two rows with the same scale and a repeated H. No dominant 3/4 panel, no 2x2 turn grid, no independent per-view scales.
environmentLayoutRule: Per sheet 6 numbered cells in a 3x2 grid, one asset per cell, a local-scale H marker in every cell. Perspective sheet first; the turnaround sheet depends on it and uses it as identity reference (4 orthographic views per cell).
notes: Sizes use only actual numeric h/V/L/W values (units of H) from docs/ASHLAR_QUY_CHUAN_QUAI_VI.md section 4; no category labels. They are provisional while Opus reviews that file.
Prologue monsters U01, U02, W01, B01 carry NO accent colour; D01-D04 and B03 keep kiln red-orange by material only.
B05 hands use a muted warm ivory skin tone (proposal about #D6C7AE, final HEX pending the docs fixer); never the Seamless white.
P05 no-infant Swaddlings rule is a production proposal derived from LD no-child-gore, not verbatim canon.
U03 'kites at range' = retreats while shooting / keeps distance.
Roster of 30 opening types confirmed by the user (25 regular + 5 bosses); L01 is not in the roster.
Folder names under monsters/ for U02-U05 and W01 are fixed by the running Astra batch.
